mapper.sql: B.BIZ_NO AS bizNo, B.BIZ_ID AS bizId, B.BIZ_TYPE AS bizType, B.BIZ_REG_NO AS bizRegNo, B.BIZ_NAME AS bizName, B.CEO_NAME AS ceoName, B.PHONE AS phone, B.STATUS_CD AS statusCd, B.JOIN_DATE AS joinDate, B.SETTLE_BANK AS settleBank, B.SETTLE_BANK_CODE AS settleBankCode, B.SETTLE_ACCOUNT AS settleAccount, B.SETTLE_HOLDER AS settleHolder, B.SETTLE_VERIFY_YN AS settleVerifyYn, B.SETTLE_VERIFY_DATE AS settleVerifyDate, A.AUTH_ID AS authId, A.APPLY_DATE AS applyDate
JOIN TB_BUSINESS_AUTH A ON A.BIZ_NO = B.BIZ_NO AND A.AUTH_ID = ( SELECT AUTH_ID FROM TB_BUSINESS_AUTH WHERE BIZ_NO = B.BIZ_NO ORDER BY APPLY_DATE DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY )
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_BUSINESS B JOIN TB_BUSINESS_AUTH A ON A.BIZ_NO = B.BIZ_NO AND A.AUTH_ID = ( SELECT AUTH_ID FROM TB_BUSINESS_AUTH WHERE BIZ_NO = B.BIZ_NO ORDER BY APPLY_DATE DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY ) WHERE B.STATUS_CD = #{statusCd}

SELECT C.COUPON_ID, C.COUPON_CODE, C.COUPON_NAME, C.COUPON_TYPE, C.DISCOUNT_VALUE, C.MIN_ORDER_AMT, C.TOTAL_BUDGET, C.ISSUED_BUDGET, C.TOTAL_QTY, C.ISSUED_QTY, C.USE_START_DATE, C.USE_END_DATE, C.BIZ_MEMBER_NO, C.APPROVAL_STATUS, C.REJECT_REASON, C.APPROVAL_DATE, C.STATUS_CD, C.REG_DATE, B.BIZ_NAME FROM TB_COUPON C LEFT JOIN TB_BUSINESS B ON B.BIZ_NO = C.BIZ_MEMBER_NO WHERE C.APPROVAL_STATUS = #{approvalStatus} ORDER BY C.REG_DATE DESC

SELECT C.COUPON_ID, C.COUPON_CODE, C.COUPON_NAME, C.COUPON_TYPE, C.DISCOUNT_VALUE, C.MIN_ORDER_AMT, C.TOTAL_BUDGET, C.ISSUED_BUDGET, C.TOTAL_QTY, C.ISSUED_QTY, C.USE_START_DATE, C.USE_END_DATE, C.BIZ_MEMBER_NO, C.APPROVAL_STATUS, C.REJECT_REASON, C.APPROVAL_DATE, C.STATUS_CD, C.REG_DATE, B.BIZ_NAME FROM TB_COUPON C LEFT JOIN TB_BUSINESS B ON B.BIZ_NO = C.BIZ_MEMBER_NO WHERE C.COUPON_ID = #{couponId}
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_COUPON SET APPROVAL_STATUS = #{approvalStatus}, STATUS_CD = #{statusCd}, APPROVAL_DATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD'), MOD_DATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') WHERE COUPON_ID = #{couponId} AND APPROVAL_STATUS = 'PENDING'

UPDATE TB_COUPON SET APPROVAL_STATUS = #{approvalStatus}, REJECT_REASON = #{rejectReason}, APPROVAL_DATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD'), MOD_DATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') WHERE COUPON_ID = #{couponId} AND APPROVAL_STATUS = 'PENDING'
